description: This Java source file defines an Android activity called NavigationDrawerActivity that manages a navigation drawer with a RecyclerView and handles fragment transactions to display different content based on user selection. It also includes inner class PlanetFragment for displaying individual planet details.

classes.name: NavigationDrawerActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the navigation drawer, handling user interactions, fragment transactions, and action bar updates.

classes.name: NavigationDrawerActivity.PlanetFragment
classes.description: Inner static fragment class used to display details about a planetary body based on selected position.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the navigation drawer, adapter, and toggle, and handles initial fragment selection.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu in the action bar.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Configures menu items visibility based on drawer state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles action bar item clicks, including toggling the drawer and web search action.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on items within the RecyclerView in the drawer, triggering content updates.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Replaces the main content fragment based on user selection, updates title, and closes drawer.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the activity's title and updates the action bar.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Synchronizes the drawer toggle state after activity restoration.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Passes configuration change events to the ActionBarDrawerToggle.
